adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` and an Ember `saveChanges` action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but the new `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` never invokes `saveChanges` (no save button/action), and host/category edits are persisted via `embeddable-host` model saves (`host.save(props)`) and `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the same `OpenStruct` without applying params, so the PUT endpoint is currently a no-op and appears unused in this PR, making it speculative/extra surface area rather than required for host/category editing.
